3Q26 Equity FCF P$351,020M, up 61.6% YoY

9M26 Equity FCF P$672,827M vs P$329,856M
The more than doubled cumulative figure indicates stronger reported cash generation versus the prior-year period.
3Q26 service revenue -1.7% YoY reported
Underlying service revenue remained pressured; excluding approximately P$39,930M in discounts, the decline was 0.2%.

The post-quarter divestiture includes a guaranteed minimum service commitment over five years; transfer and antitrust review remain relevant.
